Ptol., Tetrab. 6r, v. 3-18) whether Valens would have spoken with these words I doubt. 14-15 The words Τούτων ('Of these') ... φύσεως ('nature') seem to have been transposed by the compiler with some (v. 16-24), which he had first omitted, added later. 16 you expect οὐσίας <μεταλλασσομένης> ('of the substance <being changed>'). 17 he could have written συγκράσεσιν ἀ. ταῖς κατὰ ('to the mixtures ... to those according to'). 24 the end I do not understand. summary.headline: Planetary Effects and Aries
summary.text: Discussion of planetary effects, including benefic and malefic configurations, bodily parts and substances ruled by a planet, and the lords of various cosmic qualities. The treatment then turns to the twelve signs, beginning with Aries and its astrological classifications and effects on those born under it.
